supporting_observations.claim: At 13:40:14 UTC, a UserAssist registry value on WS-NKIM-01 was updated for a path that decodes to Windows PowerShell. This is evidence of PowerShell activity near the alert time, but does not establish a failed logon or its cause.
The provided records include a successful interactive logon for noah.kim on WS-NKIM-01 at 13:27 UTC, but do not include a failed-logon event for the alerted activity.
At 14:19 UTC, WS-GLUND-01 recorded a network logoff for noah.kim. The record does not establish when or how that session was created, or whether it relates to the reported failures around 13:40.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided sensor-status information says winsec and sysmon collection on DC-MAP-01 was unavailable for the entire review window due to a log collection outage. No record IDs were supplied for this sensor-status information.

The provided sensor-status information also says winsec and sysmon collection on FILE-MAP-01 was unavailable for the entire review window. No record IDs were supplied for this sensor-status information.
The available event records do not show the reported repeated failed domain logons, so their timestamps, source, and result cannot be verified from these records.
